events.body: Durable goods orders in the US are expected to rise 1.6% in June.
US Consumer Confidence Index is expected to rise from 91.2 to 92.1.
The US Federal Reserve is expected to keep interest rates unchanged at 3.75%.
The Producer Price Index is expected to fall 0.1% month-over-month, versus 0.3% in the previous month.
The Bank of Japan is expected to keep interest rates unchanged at 1%.
